nodes.name: manage_work_item.rs
nodes.summary: Work item (task/issue) management tool implementing CRUD, chat-session linking, batch operations, and scheduling for both project-scoped and standalone work items.

nodes.name: WorkItemTool
nodes.summary: Struct wrapping the workspace and standalone-store paths needed to resolve, read, and mutate work items across both project-scoped and standalone modes.

nodes.name: run_blocking
nodes.summary: Wraps a blocking work-item IO closure in tokio::spawn_blocking with a labeled error context.

nodes.name: read_standalone_scoped
nodes.summary: Resolves a standalone work item by short ID, trying the caller's org first then falling back to a no-org lookup.

nodes.name: optional_todos
nodes.summary: Parses the optional `todos` array param into (content, status) tuples.

nodes.name: parse_schedule
nodes.summary: Parses the optional `schedule` param object into a WorkItemSchedule.

nodes.name: batch_items
nodes.summary: Validates and merges per-item batch parameters with inherited parent fields (project_slug, session_status, agent_role).

nodes.name: execute_batch
nodes.summary: Runs each merged batch operation sequentially through a fresh WorkItemTool instance and collects OK/ERROR result lines.

nodes.name: orchestrator_overrides_from_params
nodes.summary: Extracts optional orchestrator config overrides (account, model, sub-agents, org, worktree, review config) from params.

nodes.name: todos_to_entries
nodes.summary: Converts parsed (content, status) tuples into TodoEntry records, preserving existing todo IDs by index.

nodes.name: config_from_overrides
nodes.summary: Merges OrchestratorConfigOverrides into a full OrchestratorConfig, defaulting unset fields.

nodes.name: apply_updates
nodes.summary: Applies partial-update fields from params onto a work item's frontmatter and body.

nodes.name: parse_linked_session_status
nodes.summary: Parses the session_status param into a LinkedSessionStatus enum.

nodes.name: parse_agent_role
nodes.summary: Parses the agent_role param into an AgentRole enum.

nodes.name: link_session_to_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Attaches or updates a LinkedSession entry on the work item frontmatter.

nodes.name: unlink_session_from_frontmatter
nodes.summary: Removes a linked session entry from the work item frontmatter by session id.

nodes.name: format_item
nodes.summary: Formats a WorkItemData into the LLM-facing text summary returned by list/read actions.

nodes.name: list_standalone_work_items
nodes.summary: Lists all standalone work items for an org, formatted for the LLM.

nodes.name: read_standalone_work_item
nodes.summary: Reads and formats a single standalone work item by short ID.

nodes.name: create_standalone_work_item
nodes.summary: Creates a new standalone work item from params, applying scheduling/orchestrator overrides.

nodes.name: update_standalone_work_item
nodes.summary: Applies partial updates to an existing standalone work item and persists it.

nodes.name: delete_standalone_work_item
nodes.summary: Deletes a standalone work item by short ID.

nodes.name: link_session
nodes.summary: Links a chat/session to a work item (project-scoped or standalone), creating the LinkedSession entry.

nodes.name: unlink_session
nodes.summary: Unlinks a chat/session from a work item.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the full JSON schema for the manage_work_item tool covering all CRUD/link/batch actions.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Dispatches the `action` param to the appropriate list/read/create/update/delete/link/unlink/batch handler.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel declaring the project tool submodules: manage_project (project lifecycle) and manage_work_item (work-item CRUD).

nodes.name: browser_cli_tool.rs
nodes.summary: Generic Tool implementation that shells out to a configured browser-automation CLI (Agent Browser or Playwright), passing through raw subcommands.

nodes.name: BrowserCliTool
nodes.summary: Struct holding the tool name/description/provider/CLI config; implements Tool to run raw CLI subcommands via the configured browser-CLI provider.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a BrowserCliTool instance with a fixed name/description/provider/config.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the single `command` string param schema for the raw CLI passthrough.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Splits the `command` string into args, runs it through the configured browser CLI provider, and returns formatted output.

nodes.name: control_browser_with_agent_browser.rs
nodes.summary: Factory constructing the Agent Browser CLI raw-command tool with its display name, provider, and usage description.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a BrowserCliTool configured for the Vercel agent-browser CLI provider.

nodes.name: control_browser_with_playwright.rs
nodes.summary: Factory constructing the Playwright CLI raw-command tool with its display name, provider, and usage description.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a BrowserCliTool configured for the Playwright CLI provider.

nodes.name: control_internal_browser.rs
nodes.summary: Agent-facing tool controlling the currently active ORGII internal browser WebView (webview-based Page Agent) -- list/get_state/click/input/select/scroll/mask actions with post-action URL-refresh tracking.

nodes.name: InternalBrowserAction
nodes.summary: Enum of the ten internal-browser operations (List, IsReady, GetState, Click, Input, Select, Scroll, ShowMask, HideMask, CleanUp) accepted by the tool's `action` param.

nodes.name: InternalBrowserParams
nodes.summary: Typed, deny-unknown-fields params struct for all internal-browser actions (index, text, option, direction, pages, element_index).

nodes.name: InternalBrowserTool
nodes.summary: Holds the optional Tauri AppHandle and implements Tool, dispatching each action to its execute_* handler and refreshing the reported URL after DOM-mutating actions.

nodes.name: resolve_ready_target
nodes.summary: Resolves the active browser target and verifies its Page Agent is ready, or returns an error.

nodes.name: execute_list
nodes.summary: Lists known internal-browser targets and the active one.

nodes.name: execute_is_ready
nodes.summary: Reports whether the active target's Page Agent is ready.

nodes.name: execute_get_state
nodes.summary: Reads the active target's DOM state snapshot.

nodes.name: execute_input
nodes.summary: Validates the index/text params and writes text into the target element.

nodes.name: execute_select
nodes.summary: Validates the index/option params and selects an option in the target element.

nodes.name: execute_scroll
nodes.summary: Validates scroll params and scrolls the page or an indexed scrollable element.

nodes.name: execute_clean_up
nodes.summary: Removes Page Agent highlight/overlay artifacts from the active browser.

nodes.name: action_response
nodes.summary: Builds the structured action response, refreshing and emitting the actual URL if it changed after the action.

nodes.name: refresh_location_after_action
nodes.summary: Re-reads the browser location after an action, polling until the URL changes or a timeout elapses (mode-dependent).

nodes.name: validate_scroll_pages
nodes.summary: Validates that the `pages` scroll parameter is a positive finite number.

nodes.name: active_target
nodes.summary: Builds an InternalBrowserToolTarget from the tracked active browser state, if any.

nodes.name: inactive_target_message
nodes.summary: Produces a human-readable explanation for why no active browser target is resolvable.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Parses params and dispatches to the matching execute_* handler by action.

nodes.name: control_orgii.rs
nodes.summary: ORGII GUI Action bridge (ActionBridge) that dispatches UI actions to the frontend ActionSystem over Tauri IPC and awaits a correlated response, plus the control_orgii Tool wrapper for direct GUI inspection/dispatch.

nodes.name: ActionBridge
nodes.summary: Shared FIFO-bounded map of pending oneshot senders keyed by correlation ID, used to await frontend responses to dispatched GUI actions.

nodes.name: OrgiiControlTool
nodes.summary: Tool wrapper exposing gui.inspect/gui.execute-style dispatch operations through the shared ActionBridge.

nodes.name: insert
nodes.summary: Registers a pending oneshot sender for a correlation ID, evicting the oldest pending request when at capacity.

nodes.name: resolve
nodes.summary: Resolves a pending request by correlation ID with the frontend's ActionBridgeResult, called from the Tauri command handler.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the operation/action/query/params schema for the control_orgii tool.

nodes.name: execute_gui_control_operation
nodes.summary: Dispatches list/inspect operations through the timed round-trip helper and dispatch through the direct action helper.

nodes.name: format_bridge_result
nodes.summary: Formats an ActionBridgeResult into LLM-facing text (pretty JSON on success, error message on failure).

nodes.name: execute_gui_operation_with_timeout
nodes.summary: Broadcasts an agent:ade_action inspect/list event, awaits the frontend's response via oneshot channel with a timeout, cleaning up on timeout.

nodes.name: build_ade_action_envelope
nodes.summary: Builds the JSON envelope broadcast to the frontend for a dispatched GUI action.

nodes.name: execute_gui_action_with_session
nodes.summary: The core dispatch primitive -- broadcasts the action event with a correlation ID and invoking session, awaits the frontend result with a timeout.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module barrel declaring all web-category tool implementations (browser CLI wrappers, internal browser, GUI control, web fetch/search).

nodes.name: reply_session_comment.rs
nodes.summary: Tool posting a reply to a review-comment thread on the current session via the shared ActionBridge GUI dispatch.

nodes.name: ReplySessionCommentTool
nodes.summary: Holds the shared ActionBridge; implements Tool to post session-comment replies.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the commentId/body param schema.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Validates commentId/body and dispatches a session.replyComment GUI action through the bridge.

nodes.name: spotlight.rs
nodes.summary: Tool that opens and controls the ORGII Spotlight command palette (search, workspace/branch pickers, agent-session search) via the ActionBridge.

nodes.name: SpotlightTool
nodes.summary: Holds the shared ActionBridge; implements Tool to open/drive the Spotlight command palette.

nodes.name: parameters
nodes.summary: Declares the operation/mode param schema for the eight Spotlight operations.

nodes.name: execute_text
nodes.summary: Maps the requested operation to its ActionSystem action id/params and dispatches it through the bridge with a timeout.
